messages:
morgan: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands 0m: a few partner-driven deals were flagged as 'timing risk'. Can we capture one-line status + single next action for each so exec can decide? I'll watch for 20m.

sven: Sales snapshot (super short):
- CloudWave: $385k ARR, blocker = delayed SOC2 evidence; next action: send SOC pack + schedule CISO call. Owner: sven.
- HelixHealth (via partner NorthStar): $220k ARR, blocker = partner resourcing for POC; next action: offer 48h engineering wedge + partner checklist. Owner: yasmin.
- LumaFin renew: $110k ARR, blocker = pricing alignment with channel; next action: propose 30-day onboarding credit. Owner: erin.

yasmin: Partner note: NorthStar asks for a clearer onboarding SLA before dedicating engineers. Credit + checklist should be fine; they want a single contact from us. I'll be the contact if approved.

erin: Ops/legal: I can draft credit agreement and procurement packet today. If leadership approves the wedge for HelixHealth, confirm here and I'll tag legal for the addendum.

morgan: Leadership decision needed: approve wedge + reassign 1-2 engs this sprint (revenue protection) or keep roadmap. If >$300k at risk, lean revenue.

sven: CloudWave pushes this quarter, so recommend approving SOC pack push + schedule.

yasmin: If approved, I'll coordinate NorthStar and book wedge for Mon-Tue.

standup-bot: Calendar event created: "Partner risk triage - CloudWave/Helix/LumaFin" 0m standup tomorrow 09:00 PST. Invitees: morgan, sven, yasmin, erin. Link: https://calendar.internal/evt/2078004321

morgan: Thanks 00 — please drop tracker link in thread when you post it and mark anything needing exec escalation.
